snippet.title: The Stickman Announcement Gameplay Trailer | Wishlist Now!
snippet.description:
Wishlist Now on Steam! https://store.steampowered.com/app/2781680/The_Stickman/

This Is The Stickman, a Movement-Based FPS solo-developed by Simple Shark with a big focus in Customization and goofing off with friends, while also being a fun and competitive shooter! Learn more on the Steam Page linked above!

If you don't know who I am, I'm Simple Shark, a Rocket League Modder who has worked on projects for several companies and events. I do YouTube as well but I do it for fun, not as a job. I currently go to college so this project is my distraction, but also I've wanted to make a game for years but never knew how. After finding Rocket League Modding and become familiar with Unreal Engine, I figured it was finally time to start making a full game. I've always loved anything with movement mechanics. That's why in this project, Movement is the most important thing to me

The Stickman Socials:
The Stickman Discord: https://discord.gg/3QYkbKkUW2
The Stickman Twitter: https://www.twitter.com/TheStickmanGame
The Stickman BlueSky: https://bsky.app/profile/thestickmangame.bsky.social

My Socials:
Simple Shark's Twitter: https://www.twitter.com/SimpleShark1
Simple Shark's BlueSky: https://bsky.app/profile/simpleshark.bsky.social
Simple Shark's Twitch: https://www.twitch.tv/TheSimpleShark


Hope y'all Enjoy!
